inputs.name: trufflehog_version
inputs.description: TruffleHog release to install from GitHub. Change checksums with it.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the release tarball for each architecture, from the release's trufflehog_<version>_checksums.txt. Change these with trufflehog_version.

inputs.name: targets
inputs.description: Absolute paths to scan on a timer, all in one report. When empty, the circuit installs TruffleHog and sets up no scan.

inputs.name: exclude_paths
inputs.description: Regular expressions for files to leave out, matched against each file's absolute path, such as "^/srv/backups/" or "\\.log$".

inputs.name: verify
inputs.description: Check each secret found against the service it belongs to, as TruffleHog does by default. This sends the secret to that service. False only reports what each detector matched.

inputs.name: results
inputs.description: Which findings to report, from verified, unknown (verification failed with an error) and unverified.

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: When the scan timer runs, as a systemd OnCalendar expression such as "daily" or "Sun 03:00".

inputs.name: keep
inputs.description: Number of scans to keep under /var/lib/conn3x-trufflehog. Older ones are deleted after each scan.

inputs.name: run_now
inputs.description: Scan during the apply: on the first apply, and again whenever the scan's settings change. Needs targets.
